training_basis: Reuse the user's verified installed Ollama coding model for pilots; QLoRA needs matching full-weight Hugging Face base, never infer from GGUF
curriculum_scope: Qwen main construction/test work for stages 03-06 ONLY after verified qualification. Stage 00 always Codex; all stage gates owned by Codex and human. Stages 01/02/07 optional diagnostics; 08/09 Codex.

stages.title: Setup and reference calibration
stages.task: Codex exclusively handles setup, reference calibration, environment locks and human gate.
stages.never: Never send any Stage 00 task to Qwen, including setup reports

stages.title: Import and loss inventory
stages.task: Read-only PMX import inventory/loss summary with explicit unknowns
stages.never: Import models, rewrite PMX, infer lost data or replace correct imports

stages.title: Material diagnosis and Cycles restoration
stages.task: Read-only missing texture/alpha/UV/role warning report from verified inputs
stages.never: Design or overwrite shaders; guess map roles; approve color or alpha

stages.title: Geometry repairs
stages.task: Main implementation: scoped Blender Python repair proposals for approved geometry, normals, morphs or deform weights in private derivatives.
stages.never: Never touch original/accepted blend or decide ambiguous anatomy, new topology, source correspondence, or user preference

stages.title: Native control rig
stages.task: Main implementation: scoped native rig control/mechanism construction from Codex-approved skeleton mappings and transforms.
stages.never: Never invent rest spaces/mapping, delete imported skeleton, or approve switching/deformation

stages.title: Animation-ready controls
stages.task: Main implementation: native face/viseme/reset/keying/control creation from a verified mapping and ranges.
stages.never: Never invent morph semantics, visual corrections or retarget sources; no acceptance without human

stages.title: Motion and deformation tests
stages.task: Main implementation: executable Blender animation/integrity test harnesses and observed evidence on private derivatives.
stages.never: Never modify accepted production assets, hide failures, approve rig qualification or repair upstream stages

stages.title: Final Cycles look
stages.task: Read-only render configuration and per-region numerical comparison evidence report
stages.never: Judge appearance, optimize shader/lighting creatively or claim Cycles rendering

stages.title: Editable native physics
stages.task: For now, Codex runs physics tests and evaluates collision/secondary motion
stages.never: Local model physics design, parameter fitting or approval

stages.title: Audit and delivery
stages.task: For now, Codex performs actual clean-open, benchmark and human delivery gates
stages.never: Local model delivery approval or fabricated test evidence
